Interzone Editions is an organization, record label, and artists’ collective that has brought together musicians, writers, audiovisual creators, and filmmakers since 2018.

Our work centers on label activities and event curation. From the start, our intention has remained the same: to organize programs that make room for unexpected meetings between genres, practices, and artists. We are interested in creating intermediary spaces—points of contact where different, and sometimes contrasting, artistic approaches can coexist and interact.

We often encourage the artists we invite to present new or unreleased work, and we try to place these performances in settings that support experimentation, whether through unconventional venues, first-time collaborations, or formats that allow for a degree of risk.

Our programming has focused mainly on contemporary musical practices, including electronic and electroacoustic music, musique concrète, experimental music, and free improvisation. We regularly present international artists while maintaining a strong commitment to local musicians from Québec and Montréal.
In 2021, we launched the Interzone Editions label to provide a platform for the sound and visual works of the many artists who have been part of our events.
Since February 2019, we have also hosted a monthly radio show on the Montréal community web station n10.as, where we share musical discoveries, discuss upcoming events, and present new releases.
We have published two zines (2019 and 2021), bringing together essays, poems, photographs, and visual works selected through open calls to the wider Interzone community.
